create_DataContainer_with_tensor: create a DataContainer wrapping a PyTorch tensor with stack and padding options
create_DataContainer_with_numpy: create a DataContainer wrapping a NumPy array with cpu_only mode enabled
use_assert_tensor_type_decorator: use the assert_tensor_type decorator to guard methods that require tensor data
access_DataContainer_properties: access DataContainer properties like data, datatype, stack, padding_value, and pad_dims
call_DataContainer_size_dim: call the size and dim methods on a DataContainer to inspect tensor shape
